newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-NORMAN, BERASATEGUI UPSET AT U.S. PRO CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-NORMAN, BERASATEGUI UPSET AT U.S. PRO CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Seventh seed Magnus Norman of Sweden and eighth seed Alberto Berasategui of Spain were upset in the first round of the U.S. Pro Tennis Championships at the historic Longwood Cricket Club on Monday.
Slava Dosedel of the Czech Republic outlasted Norman 6-3 6-7 (5-7) 7-6 (7-3), while Galo Blanco bounced fellow Spaniard Berasategui 7-6 (7-3) 3-6 6-3.
Second seed Marcelo Rios of Chile successfully navigated the first round. The 10th-ranked Rios advanced with a 6-7 6-2 7-6 victory over American Jonathan Stark.
Stark dominated the first-set tie-break 7-1, but Rios returned the favor with the match on the line by winning the third-set breaker by the same score.
Top seed Alex Corretja of Spain, who has three titles on clay this year, opens against countryman Francisco Clavet in this final hardcourt tune-up for the U.S. Open.
The tournament's main attraction however is German star Boris Becker, who could be preparing for his final U.S. Open.

The fourth-seeded Becker, who announced he had played his final Wimbledon in July and suggested he was heading for the home stretch of his brilliant career, will face Fernando Meligeni of Brazil in the opening round.
Becker, who won the 1990 U.S. Open, said after his loss to Pete Sampras at Wimbledon this year that he felt he was no longer a serious contender for the sport's major titles.
